academicComparability: Three evidence-backed related routes respond to the defining public problem, policy, institution and organisational substance. General coherence or environmental/business labels alone do not establish comparability under the CP119 distinction. Five science/engineering placements in the climate route and three generic business placements in the organisations route are replaced with stronger public, social and empirical study. Housing and poverty remain evidenced public problems; the separate candidate lacks a sustained available housing-policy sequence beyond general economics and sociology, so it is not included under a new label. Public Policy Analysis exists in the workbook but is unavailable in the planned semesters and cannot fill that gap.
